error.description: Error message (renders aria-describedby and error class)

options.description: Array of { value, label } option objects

onSearch.description: Called on every keystroke in the text input; receives (value: string)

onSelect.description: Called when an option is selected or cleared; receives (value: string, option: object|null)

formGroup.description: Whether to wrap the label/hint/error/control in a `.usa-form-group`. Set to `false` when composing inside another form group.
